description:
RESTATED 2026-09-03 after research (prototype E') and a cold review (BLOCK,
precise prerequisite). Base 0889c0b3a.

THE MECHANISM: Types::convergence_class_at (types/mod.rs:780-796), reached
from World::canonical_activation_key's recursive branch (world.rs:1884) via
convergence_collapse (:845) and its DispatchDemand::Ignore arm (:1016-1032),
turns a pure list slot into list(address_var) and a pure callable slot into
address_var -- fz-y6w bounded specialization as documented ("list(int) and
list(any) share one recursive key"). List.reduce_step/3's mask is [Ignore,
TupleFields({0: Whole}), Ignore] so its key is [[a0_e], {:cont, [a1_1_e]},
a2]: ONE activation for every Enum.reduce/3 user, one JOINED return.
reduce_cont/3 escapes only because its ListShape(Ignore) mask descends to the
element; nest the element one list deeper and it collapses too.

THE INVARIANT VIOLATED: an activation's published return may depend only on
what its key names. reduce_step/3 FORWARDS the list to reduce_cont/3 whose key
IS ground in the element, so the element decides the callee activation and
the return; the key erased it. LIVE AT HEAD, all three doors (repro183.fz):
    dbg(Enum.with_index([["a"], ["b"]], fn (x, _i) -> M.strings(x) end))
    dbg(Enum.with_index([[1], [2]], fn (_x, i) -> i end))
-> error[spec/violation]: strings/1 ... ([binary] | [int]); delete the
second line and it prints [1, 1]. Also at HEAD: swapping two independent
statements flips reduce_step/3's published return FACT (fz-kdt.190). The @spec
results of List.reduce_cont/3 / Enum.reduce/3 silently re-correlate the
joined return per callsite today; fz-kdt.120's honest rule removes that
accident, which is why 120 is blocked here (proto120 alone turns
enum_map_family red with a phantom spec/violation on */2; with the element
keyed it is green).

POPULATION: 146 blind-shared activations (free var in key AND >= 2
publishers with different evidence) over 30 functions / 46 fixtures.

WHAT E' (keep the element in EVERY list slot, 18 lines) BUYS AND COSTS,
measured on 597 fixtures: repro green on three doors; corpus FIFO/LIFO canon
movers 2 -> 0 (00277 and dead_closure byte-identical); enum_predicate_search
206 -> 166 executables and its blind-escape census 3 -> 0; EVERY LIVE
SURFACE-MEMBERSHIP ESCAPE ON THE CENSUS RETIRED (00277 12 -> 0, arms:6 12 ->
0, enum_predicate_search 1 -> 0 -- fz-kdt.179's reproducer included); blind-
shared 146 -> 78; 0 behaviour movers; enum_map_family green with 120 stacked.
COST: executables 5297 -> 5383 (+86, every riser a list-accumulator walker)
because (a) list_element_type([]) is none so every accumulator mints a
{empty_list(), list(τ)} ladder whose product is 2^k (partition/4 1 -> 4,
split4/6 1 -> 16, all code-identical) -> fz-kdt.124 BLOCKS this ticket; and
(b) E' is NOT NECESSARY: a slot the body never reads nor forwards (loop(n,
junk) with junk `nothing carrier=Absent`) splits from 1 to 2 activations
with identical bodies -- freight splits the invariant never asks about.

THE RULE (researched, prototyped proto183r.diff, cold-reviewed APPROVE WITH
FIXES 2026-09-03): demand(f, i) = local(f, i) ⊔ ⨆{ demand(g, j) : f forwards
i to g@j } over the DispatchDemand lattice (Ignore ⊑ ListShape/TupleFields ⊑
Whole, joined by join_assign; depth never grows past the deepest local mask
-- proven, 0 of 4,897 evaluations); "forwarded" = a direct-call tail argument
equal to a clause parameter (projections, constructions, closure calls and
captures are opaque -- that is why partition/4 and List.reverse/2 stay ONE
activation while List.reduce_step/3 splits); protocol callbacks forward every
input to every implementation (a STATIC over-approximation of a runtime
dispatch -- an unrelated defimpl can raise a forwarder's slot to Whole; say
so in the doc); one job walks the FORWARDING cone (mean 2.9 nodes, max 54),
reads StaticCallees / EntryDispatch / LoweredBody / ProtocolDispatch /
FunctionDefined / ModuleDefined (all in `reads`), Kleene least fixpoint from
the cone's LOCAL masks (never another function's fact -- no wait cycle), and
publishes the row; convergence_class_at keeps the element only where demand
reaches it (keep_elements; freight still collapses to list(address_var)).

FOUR FIXES IN THE COMMIT (from the review): (1) erase_transported_closure_
identities keys brand erasure off DispatchDemand::Ignore, so a slot the rule
raises stops being erased -- k1_brand_coupling.fz (apply2(:none, x) forces
Whole; fwd(f, x) transport-only) splits fwd/2 into 2 activations = fz-6gb's
law BROKEN; publish the LOCAL mask as a co-value of the fact and erase
against the local half (0 canon movers vs the rule; k1 back to 1). (2) RENAME
where the meaning changes: FactKey::DispatchMask -> InputDemand carrying
{ local_dispatch, forwarded_dispatch } (fz-kdt.165 adds identity on the same
walk), DispatchDemand's module doc, DispatchMaskMap, define_dispatch_mask,
dispatch_input_mask -> local_dispatch_mask, the telemetry event, the
require_activation_key_facts docs; consumers world.rs:1674,
runtime_demand.rs:3240, backend.rs:147 (the latter two pure readiness
gates). (3) The rung acceptance restated: NO rung the rule creates sits on a
FREIGHT slot of a recursive key (measured 0); the six new rungs (53/15 ->
58/16) are four code-different honest specializations on demanded slots
(Map.reverse/2, Range.reverse/2, Map.to_list/4 slot 3, Range.slice_from/5
slot 4) and two on non-recursive dbg keys -- residue recorded on fz-kdt.182.
(4) Whole propagation documented: a Whole slot has no collapse and forwarding
can hand a Whole up (344 rows / 174 functions; fz-kdt.200 owns the cure). Plus:
guard the bare FactKey::ProtocolDispatch wait like semantic.rs:1376 (no
producer arm in demand_fact_producer); record ModuleDefined(module) in the
provider-boundary arm's reads; delete the FZ183MASK scaffold.

RED-FIRST GATES: repro183 [1, 1] / [0, 1] three doors; fz-kdt.122's oracle
(kdt122.fz + kdt122_flip.fz, .oracle.exs from Elixir 1.19.4: [12, 11] then
["b!", "a!"]) three doors BOTH orders; c1_listshape_elem.fz no panic;
List.reduce_step/3 keys [[int], {:cont, list(a1_1_e)}, a2] (slot 1's payload
and slot 2 stay free); anti-blend b1/b2 publish ([binary] | [int]) in both
orders; corpus FIFO/LIFO canon movers <= 1 (dead_closure until 120) with the
executable count schedule-independent; NEW k1_brand_coupling.fz keys ONE
fwd/2 activation. GREEN-AND-STAYS: loop(n, junk) 1 activation; partition/4
1 activation at 17 executables; split3/5 and split4/6 1 each; both quicksort
gates, the four old-law keying tests, recursive_keying_sees_recursion and
cmp_tys_canonical_order UNMOVED (E' moved every one -- the rule's strongest
argument). b1n/b2n/b4 (identical drivers, different lambdas) are fz-kdt.165's
gates, not this ticket's.

MEASURED (base 8de517a28): interp 0 / run 0 movers; canon 52 movers (risers:
enum_predicate_search 206 -> 166; List.subtract/2 grounding on three operator
fixtures = half honest, half fz-kdt.182's duplicate-row class); executables
5,297 -> 5,282; FIFO/LIFO 2 -> 1, LIFO executables = FIFO (base 5,298 !=
5,297); blind-escape census 48 -> 29 (0 new; dispatch_list_head_separates and
both enum_predicate_search entries retire -- fz-kdt.131 must decide its
reproducer), seat findings 73 -> 29, twins per site -> 1, 179's dynamic
reproducer 1 -> 0; DeriveCallGraphComponent 134 -> 126 (real: StaticCallees
pre-demanded) but DeriveDispatchMask evaluations 200 -> 256 and reads per
evaluation 1 -> mean 8.6 (max 160): total job spans 2,379 -> 2,419 -- state
both; wall clock corpus -13% carried by enum_predicate_search (00420 +5%);
lib 8 movers (2 re-pins, 5 cures, 1 vacuous gate: capture-surfaces --
re-aim or record the loss); matrix 485/0/9; with 120 stacked
enum_map_family / enum_tier0 / fz_f98_map_reduce byte-equal to expected and
dead_closure + 00277 byte-identical FIFO/LIFO. The "blind-shared 146 -> 136"
figure needs its census emitter shipped or dropped.

KNOWN LIMIT (stated, not claimed away): the invariant "a return depends only
on what the key names" is NOT proven by this rule -- fz-kdt.199 (a returned tuple
FIELD at a recursive key is freight: g0n.fz blends) and fz-kdt.165 (the
callable slot) are the two remaining axes on the same derivation.

RIP-OUT / DOCS: convergence_collapse's "list(int) and list(any) share one
recursive key" (true only of freight), convergence_class_at's doc, type-
specialization.md:105-124 (slots keyed by convergence_class; the collapse
"shaped by the inputs that drive clause selection" -- both false; add the
Whole statement), addressed-arrow.md:136-143, type-world.md:73-76, specs.md,
dispatch-matrix.md:746 (three -> one -> zero with 120), semantic-fixpoint.md,
drive_test.rs:10240-10246; censuses edited DOWN with the cure. BLOCKS fz-
kdt.120 and fz-kdt.199. ORDER: lands right after fz-kdt.186 (independent of 192/184:
never touches arrow_match); then 184 -> 192 -> 120.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE (2026-09-03, prototype + corpus; report + proto183.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). THE MECHANISM: Types::convergence_class_at (types/mod.rs:780-796) turns a pure list slot into list(address_var) and a pure callable into address_var on the RECURSIVE key branch (World::canonical_activation_key :1884 -> convergence_collapse :845 -> Ignore arm :1016-1032) -- fz-y6w bounded specialization as documented ("list(int) and list(any) share one recursive key"). reduce_cont/3 escapes only because its mask is ListShape(Ignore) and the descent reaches the element; nest the element one list deeper and it collapses too. THE DEFECT IS LIVE AT HEAD, not only under 120: repro183.fz (dbg(Enum.with_index([["a"], ["b"]], fn (x, _i) -> M.strings(x) end)) beside an independent int with_index) fails with error[spec/violation]: strings/1 ... ([binary] | [int]) on interp, run AND build; delete the neighbour and it prints [1, 1]. Also proven at HEAD: swapping two independent statements flips reduce_step/3's published return FACT (fz-kdt.190). POPULATION: 146 blind-shared activations (free var in key AND >=2 publishers with different evidence) over 30 functions / 46 fixtures; Enum.reduce_while/3 32, List.reduce_cont/3 20, ... CANDIDATES measured: keep the callable in the key -> 7 fixtures hit the multi-target-closure arg-floor (fz-kdt.189, blocked behind runtime demand); per-row/per-publisher return correlation -> quicksort prints [3] (rows are the caller's own ASCENT HISTORY as well as publishers; the cross-row join IS the fixpoint); stop the coalesce blend -> sound but does not cure (fz-kdt.188). RECOMMENDED E': convergence_class_at keeps the list ELEMENT (18 lines): repro green on three doors, corpus FIFO/LIFO canon movers 2 -> 0 (dead_closure AND 00277 byte-identical), enum_predicate_search's blind-escape census empties, blind-shared 146 -> 78; cost executables 5297 -> 5383 (+1.6%) and the fz-y6w quicksort frontier bound moves (partition/4 1 -> 4; convergence still identical on every schedule) -- the bound must be RE-DERIVED, not re-pinned, which is the cold review's first question. With fz-kdt.120's prototype on top: enum_map_family GREEN, enum_tier0 + fz_f98_map_reduce oracle-exact. Gate 2 as written ("no free type variable") is not met by E' -- the callable slot stays a2 (fz-kdt.189); restate to the list and accumulator positions.

RESEARCH DONE, RULE PROTOTYPED (2026-09-03, proto183r.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). demand(f,i) = local(f,i) ⊔ ⨆{demand(g,j) : f forwards i to g@j} over the DispatchDemand lattice; forwarded = a direct-call tail arg equal to a clause param (projections/constructions/closure calls/captures are opaque); protocol callbacks forward to every implementation (FactKey::ProtocolDispatch); one job walks the forwarding cone and runs the Kleene least fixpoint; convergence_class_at keeps the element only where demand arrives (keep_elements). MEASURED (base 8de517a28): repro183 [1, 1]/[0, 1] and fz-kdt.122's oracle [12, 11]/["b!", "a!"] on three doors in both orders; partition/4 stays ONE activation (17 execs), freight loop(n, junk) ONE, split3/4 ONE; corpus interp/run 0 movers; executables 5297 -> 5282; FIFO/LIFO movers 2 -> 1 (0 with 120 stacked; LIFO execs = FIFO); blind-escape census 48 -> 29 (dispatch_list_head_separates and both enum_predicate_search entries retire); seat findings 73 -> 29; twins per site -> 1; 179's dynamic reproducer (enum_predicate_search arms:6) 1 -> 0; blind-shared 146 -> 136 (reduce_step/3 gone); wall clock 00420 1883 -> 1334 ms, enum_predicate_search 729 -> 366 ms; DeriveCallGraphComponent evaluations 134 -> 126; the four old-law keying tests and both quicksort gates UNMOVED (E' moved all of them); lib 1605/8/5 (2 re-pins, 5 cures, 1 vacuous gate), matrix 485/0/9; with 120 stacked enum_map_family/enum_tier0/fz_f98_map_reduce byte-equal to expected. RESIDUE: b1n/b2n/b4 (identical driver + seed, different lambda: only the a2 slot differs) still panic -- the minimal pair (kdt122 cured, b1n not) proves they are fz-kdt.165's callable axis, not this ticket's; rung census 53/15 -> 58/16: six rungs at accumulator slots genuinely forwarded into a dispatch (Map.to_list/4 + Map.reverse/2, Range.slice_from/5 + Range.reverse/2, dbg/1 + fz_dbg_value/1 on 00277) -- the rule's own law, one accumulator per function, not 2^k; the 'must not grow' acceptance is under review (restate to 'no rung on a freight slot' vs the pre-existing empty_list()/list(τ) non-convergence at demanded slots as its own item). Composition with 165: one cone walk, two demand axes (InputDemand { dispatch, identity }); erase_transported_closure_identities keys brand erasure off DispatchDemand::Ignore -- a dispatch-axis/callable-axis coupling to move to the identity axis.

title: A recursive activation key keeps a list element wherever demand reaches it -- through forwarding, not everywhere -- so one Enum.reduce/3 user cannot publish another user's return
